問題: Ms. James had her hat (     ) away by the wind.
解説: have + O + 過去分詞(被害)「帽子を風に飛ばされた」。blow - blew - blown。

問題: He got the maintenance person (     ) the TV set.
解説: get + O + to V「Oに〜してもらう」。get the maintenance person to repair ~。

問題:
Fans got their faces (     ) red and white to support the Japanese football team.
【和訳】ファンたちは、サッカー日本代表を応援するために顔を赤と白に塗った。
解説: get + O + 過去分詞「Oを〜してもらう」。faces は「塗られる」側なので painted。

問題: We were having tea in the kitchen, when we heard something (     ).
解説: hear + O + 原形「Oが〜するのを聞く」。heard something explode。

There (     ) usually a lot of (     ) in the city at this time of the day.
解説: There is + 不可算名詞 traffic。traffic は不可算。

問題:
"The meeting this morning didn't last more than 25 minutes."
"It (     )? That's quick. It usually takes us an hour at least."
解説: 相手の didn't last を受けた聞き返し(相づち)で、助動詞 did を使う。It didn't?「そうなの?」。

問題:
"The meeting this morning didn't last more than 25 minutes."
"It didn't? That's quick. It usually (     ) us an hour at least."
解説: It takes + 人 + 時間「(人に)時間がかかる」。It usually takes us an hour。

問題: Forgive me (     ) late. The train was delayed by the rain.
解説: forgive + 人 + for ~ing「〜したことを許す」。for being late。

問題: Forgive me for being late. The train was delayed (     ) the rain.
解説: be delayed by ~「〜で遅れる」(原因・行為者の by)。

問題:
話してもいいですか。
Do you (     ) if I speak to you?
解説: Do you mind if ~?「〜してもいいですか」。承諾は No, not at all.

問題:
話してもいいですか。
(     ) I speak to you?
解説: May I ~?「〜してもよろしいですか」(許可を求める)。

問題:
次の定義に当てはまる英単語を答えなさい。
an arrangement to see someone, for example a doctor, at a particular time
解説: appointment =「(医者などと会う)約束・予約」。定義は「特定の時間に医者などと会う取り決め」。

問題: 次の英文の中で，「誤りのあるもの」を選びなさい。
選択肢A: The soldiers laid down their arms.
選択肢B: I had to lay down for a while.
選択肢C: They all needed to lie down.
選択肢D: He lied to all of us.
解説: lie down(自動詞:横になる)の活用は lie - lay - lain。誤りはB(lay down → lie down)。Aは lay(他動詞)down their arms は「武器を置く」。

問題:
次の英文には不要な語が1つ含まれている。その語を答えなさい。
The president has been considering of expanding his business in Asia, by merging with local companies.
【和訳】社長は、現地企業との合併によってアジアで事業を拡大することを検討している。
解説: consider は他動詞なので of は不要。considering expanding ~ が正しい形。

問題:
Mike is <u>looked on</u> as a good politician.
下線部とほぼ同じ意味を表す語を答えなさい。(r で始まる過去分詞)
解説: look on A as B「AをBとみなす」≒ regard A as B。受動態 be looked on as ~ = be regarded as ~。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Susie is <u>on good terms</u> with Jenny.
解説: be on good terms with ~「〜と仲がよい」。【同意表現】be friendly with ~。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Darwin recognized that his book <u>raised</u> many unanswered questions.
解説: raise a question「疑問を提起する」。raise = introduce for consideration。

問題:
空所に入れるのに，「不適切なもの」を選びなさい。
I asked her (     )
選択肢A: if she could go to the party.
選択肢C: what she wanted me to do about it.
選択肢D: that I wanted to borrow her dictionary.
解説: ask + 人 + that 節は不可。ABCは ask の用法として正しい。

問題:
２つの文が同じような意味になるように，空所に入る適語を選びなさい。
(A) Why did she say such a thing?
(B) What (     ) her say such a thing?
解説: What made her say ~?「何が彼女に〜と言わせたか」(= Why did she say ~?)。

問題:
２つの文が同じような意味になるように，空所に入る適語を選びなさい。
(A) She was too proud to show her grief in public.
(B) Her pride (     ) her from showing her grief in public.
解説: keep + O + from ~ing「Oが〜するのを妨げる」。Her pride kept her from showing ~。

問題:
日本語の意味に合う英文を選びなさい。
この事業に彼の協力を期待するなんて，私はなんてバカだったことか。
選択肢A: How foolish I was that I think he can expect to help this project!
選択肢B: How foolish I am to expect to have got his assistance with this project!
選択肢C: What a fool I am that I could expect this project with his help!
選択肢D: What a fool I was to have expected him to assist us in this project!
解説: What a fool I was to have expected ~「〜を期待するなんて、なんて愚かだったことか」。完了不定詞で過去を表す。

問題: A pen? I'm sure I have (     ) with me.
解説: 不特定の「ペン(1本)」を受ける代名詞は one。「ペン?持っているはずです」。it は特定のものを指すので不可。

問題: These are too expensive. May I see some cheaper (     )?
解説: some cheaper one(s) の one は前出の these(= 品物)を受ける代名詞。選択肢の中では one が正解で、other は単独で名詞にならず、any / it も不適。【別解】some cheaper ones(複数形)がより自然。

問題: I prefer my new school to the (     ) I went to before.
解説: the + one = the school(前出名詞の繰り返し)。the one I went to before =「前に通っていた学校」。that は関係詞節が続く場合は使わない。

問題:
You will find that teaching styles in the US are very different from (     ) in other countries.
【和訳】アメリカの教え方は、他国のそれとは大きく異なることがわかるだろう。
解説: 前出の複数名詞 teaching styles の繰り返しなので those(of 以外にも in ~ の修飾が続く)。what は先行詞を含むので不可。

問題: The legs of a horse are longer than (     ) of a sheep.
解説: The legs ... than those of a sheep。複数名詞の繰り返しは those of ~。

問題: (     ) who would like to go on a trip should put their names on the list.
解説: those who ~「〜する人々」。「旅行に行きたい人はリストに名前を書いてください」。

問題: Our seats are here and (     ) are over there.
解説: ours / theirs など独立所有格。theirs = their seats。「私たちの席はここで、彼らの席はあそこです」。

問題: (     ) of my friends came all the way from Korea.
解説: Both of my friends ~「私の友人は2人とも」。But / Nor / And は文頭に置いて名詞句を導けない。

問題: In my opinion (     ) of the candidates is particularly suitable for the position.
解説: neither of the candidates「どちらの候補者も〜ない」。2人についての否定。【別解】none of(3人以上)。

問題: We could sit on (     ) side of the table.
解説: either side of ~「(2つのうち)どちらの側にも」。

問題: We canceled the party because (     ) of the people we invited could come.
解説: none of the people ~「〜な人は1人も…ない」。nobody / anybody は of を直接取れない。

問題:
彼らはお互いのことを非常によく知っていると言っています。
They say they know (     ) very well.
解説: each other「お互い」。【同意表現】one another。

問題:
私の好きな元オリンピック選手が，一日おきにこのスポーツ・クラブに来ているらしい。
I hear my favorite former Olympic athlete comes to this fitness club every (     ) day.
解説: every other day「1日おきに」。【同意表現】every second day / every two days。

問題: (     ) are from the northern part of Japan.
解説: Most of my friends「友達のほとんど」。almost は形容詞的に使えず、most of ~ の形にする。

問題:
(     )(     ) Japanese kids like to play the computer games.
【和訳】ほとんどすべての日本の子どもはコンピューターゲームをして遊ぶのが好きだ。
解説: almost all + 名詞「ほとんどすべての〜」。almost は副詞で、直接名詞は修飾できない(Almost Japanese kids は不可)。

問題: Table manners differ from one country to (     ).
解説: from one country to another「ある国から別の国へ」。

問題: I have three daughters: one is in Boston and (     ) in Seattle.
解説: one ... and the other(s)「一方は…もう一方は」。3人姉妹なので残り2人は the others are。

問題: What they say is one thing, but what they do is (     ).
解説: A is one thing, B is another「AとBは別物だ」。

問題: If our luck holds, we will reach London in (     ) two hours or so.
解説: another + 数詞 + 複数名詞「さらに〜」(another two hours)。

問題:
A：Can you join me for lunch after this lecture?
B：(     ) Where are we eating?
A：In the student cafeteria on the 17th floor. I love the view from there. Find me there at 12:20.
解説: 昼食の誘いに応じる返事として I guess so.「そう思うよ(OK)」。後に「どこで食べる?」と続く。

問題: "Will it be fine tomorrow?" "I'm afraid (     )."
解説: I'm afraid not.「残念ながらそうではないでしょう」(= I'm afraid it won't be fine tomorrow)。

問題: They had (     ) to do with the accident.
解説: have nothing to do with ~「〜と関係がない」。

問題: There is something (     ) with my computer.
解説: something wrong with ~「〜の調子が悪い」。

問題: "Did you have a good time in Hawaii?" "Very much so. I enjoyed (     ) golf in beautiful weather."
解説: enjoy + ~ing「〜して楽しむ」。enjoyed playing golf。

問題:
お好きなものをご自由にどうぞ。
Please help yourself (     ) anything you like.
解説: help oneself to ~「〜を自由に取って食べる」。

問題: After all her family members had left, she stayed at home (     ) herself.
解説: by oneself「ひとりで」。【同意表現】alone。

問題: Because of his business problem John is always (     ) himself with worry.
解説: beside oneself with ~「〜で我を忘れて」。beside himself with worry。

問題: I can speak only (     ) of Italian.
解説: a few words of ~「少しの〜語」。可算の words は a few。

問題: Although it was Sunday, there were a (     ) number of students at the university.
解説: a large number of ~「多数の」。number の大小は large / small。

問題: Mr. Brown said that his trip was very (     ).
解説: interesting は物事が主語のとき(trip が「興味深い」)。

問題:
I'm not (     ) in tennis. I think it's really boring.
【和訳】私はテニスに興味がない。本当に退屈だと思う。
解説: be interested in ~「〜に興味がある」。人が主語のときは過去分詞形 interested。

問題:
I saw the new Tom Cruise movie yesterday! It was so (     ) that I couldn't sleep all night!
【和訳】昨日トム・クルーズの新作映画を見た!とても興奮して、一晩中眠れなかった!
解説: 映画(物事)が主語で「人を興奮させる」→ exciting。人が主語なら excited。

問題: Everyone was (     ) at the concert.
解説: 主語が人 Everyone なので excited「興奮した」。

問題: Samantha is so much fun! Life with her is never (     )!
解説: Life with her が主語(物事)で「退屈な」→ boring。

問題: Tom doesn't have anything to do now. I'm sure he (     ).
解説: 人(he)が主語で「退屈している」→ is bored。

問題: He felt (     ) but he tried to put on a brave face.
解説: 人が主語で「がっかりした」→ disappointed。

問題: There is no doubt that learning new languages is more difficult once you are an adult, but (     ) certainly not impossible.
解説: it is (certainly not impossible)。主語は learning new languages を受ける it。

問題: The fire spread through the building quickly, but everybody (     ) escape.
解説: was able to「(実際に)逃げることができた」(過去の1回の事実)。could は不可。

問題: I wonder if John is (     ) such a job.
解説: be capable of ~ing「〜する能力がある」。

問題: This orange costs twice as (     ) as that one.
解説: twice as much as ~「〜の2倍の(価格)」。price に対応して much。

問題: The actors were pleased that there was such a large (     ) for the first night of the new play.
解説: audience「観客」。「新作の初日に大勢の観客」。

問題: "Hey! Smell these roses. Don't they have a nice fragrance?" "Mmm... Nice, but roses all smell (     ) to me."
解説: smell alike「同じような香りがする」。alike は叙述用法の形容詞。

問題: The United States exports (     ) products to Panama.
解説: industrial products「工業製品」。industrious は「勤勉な」。

問題: She's a (     ) businessperson because she works very hard.
解説: successful businessperson「成功した実業家」(形容詞)。

問題: Murakami's books are very interesting. He is a very (     ) writer.
解説: imaginative writer「想像力豊かな作家」。imaginary は「架空の」。

問題:
A leader must be (     ) to the needs of other people.
【和訳】指導者は他の人々のニーズに敏感でなければならない。
解説: be sensitive to ~「〜に敏感だ」。sensible は「分別のある」、sensational は「センセーショナルな」。

問題: I am thirsty. Please give me (     ).
解説: something + 形容詞 + to V の語順。something cold to drink。

問題: It is (     ) bus ride from the station to the amusement park.
解説: a ten-minute bus ride。数詞+単位のハイフン形容詞では単位は単数形。

問題:
Even my (     ) grandchild can answer such an easy question.
【和訳】6歳の孫でさえこんな簡単な問題には答えられる。
解説: 数詞+単位をハイフンでつないで形容詞にするとき、単位は単数形。six-year-old grandchild。

問題: Jim wasn't able to swim well when he fell into the (     ) river.
解説: five-foot-deep river「深さ5フィートの川」(形容詞的に使うとき foot は単数形)。

問題: Catherine has (     ) finished her homework.
解説: already「もう〜した」(肯定文の完了)。yet は否定・疑問で使う。

問題: I am not (     ) finished with that book.
解説: not ... yet「まだ〜ない」。

問題: "When was the last time you visited England?" "(     )"
解説: When was the last time ~?への答えは過去の時点 Three years ago.。

問題: Robert (     ) goes to concerts because they are so expensive.
解説: seldom「めったに〜ない」。because they are so expensive と合う。

問題: The train reached the station so late that I (     ) missed the bus to the university.
解説: almost missed「あやうく〜しそこなう」。hardly は否定の意味。

問題: You should exercise a little each day; (     ), your health will suffer.
解説: otherwise「さもなければ」。「毎日少し運動しなさい。さもないと健康を損なう」。

問題: Clouds normally appear white when the light that strikes them is scattered by the small ice or water particles of which clouds are composed. However, when the size of these ice and water particles increases ─ as it does just before clouds begin to produce rain ─ light is no longer scattered and instead is absorbed. (     ), much less light reaches the observer on the ground below and the clouds look darker.
解説: As a result「その結果」。雲の粒が大きくなるとその結果暗く見える。

問題:
Taro had a cold on the day of his driving test. (     ), he passed it.
【和訳】タロウは運転免許試験の日に風邪をひいていた。それにもかかわらず合格した。
解説: Nevertheless「それにもかかわらず」(接続副詞)。Although / Since / While は接続詞で、文頭にピリオドの後では使えない。

問題: My computer is very old. I want to buy a new (     ).
解説: a new one(= a new computer)。one は不特定の可算名詞を受ける。

問題: It took that company over five years before (     ) achieved commercial success.
解説: before it achieved ~(it = that company)。

問題: Could you explain the difference between bread made in Japan and (     )?
解説: bread made in Japan and American bread「日本製のパンとアメリカのパン」。one は修飾語がつくと American one と言えない。

問題: (     ) useful to know more than one language.
解説: It is useful to know ~(形式主語 it)。

問題: She found (     ) impossible to get to the theater before the play began.
解説: found it impossible to ~(形式目的語 it)。

問題:
The temperature of the water is much warmer than (     ) of the air.
【和訳】水の温度は空気の温度よりずっと暖かい。
解説: 比較の対象を合わせる。単数名詞 the temperature の繰り返しは that。

問題: The cars made in the U.S.A. are more expensive than (     ) made in Japan.
解説: The cars ... those made in Japan。複数名詞の繰り返しは those。

問題: The symptoms are similar to (     ) of depression.
解説: similar to those of depression。symptoms の繰り返しで those。

問題: Those (     ) were all very glad to hear of the birth of a royal baby boy.
解説: Those present「出席者」(those who were present)。present は後置形容詞。

問題: I ran across an old boyfriend of (     ) on the subway train.
解説: an old boyfriend of mine「私の昔のボーイフレンド」(二重所有格)。

問題: (     ) student who got under 40 on the test has to take additional class.
解説: Any student who ~「〜する学生はみな」。

問題: Both of them are very smart, but (     ) warm-hearted.
解説: neither of them is「どちらも〜ない」。単数扱いが標準。

問題: (     ) working mother would prefer to work part-time, but relatively few do.
解説: Every working mother「働く母親は誰もが」。後の relatively few do と対比。

問題: The Olympic Games are held (     ) four years.
解説: every four years「4年ごとに」。【同意表現】every fourth year。

問題: (     ) my friends live in Tokyo.
解説: Most of my friends「私の友達のほとんど」。

問題: (     ) college students have mobile phones.
解説: Most college students「大学生のほとんど」。most + 名詞(of なし)。

問題: He has two sisters. One is a teacher; (     ) is a doctor.
解説: One ..., the other ...「一方は…、もう一方は…」(2人のとき)。

問題: Having listened to our story, Mary said that he was indeed such a fool and I was (     ).
解説: I was another(fool)「私も同様に愚か者だった」。such a fool and I was another。

問題: He is always speaking ill of (     ) behind their backs.
解説: speak ill of others「他人の悪口を言う」。

問題: We are staying here for (     ) few days.
解説: another few days「あと数日」(another + few + 複数名詞)。

問題: “It doesn't often happen." “No, I suppose (     )."
解説: I suppose not.「そうではないと思う」。

問題: Exercise and diet must have something to do (     ) good health.
解説: have something to do with ~「〜と関係がある」。

問題: He always gets excited when he talks about disease. Is he (     ) of a doctor?
解説: something of a doctor「ちょっとした医者/医者のようなもの」。

問題:
Daughter： Do you have any coffee?
Mother： Yes. It's in the pot. (     )!
解説: Help yourself!「ご自由にどうぞ」。

問題: Only (     ) companies will be able to benefit from the new regulation.
解説: only a few companies「ごく少数の会社」。most だと Only most で不自然。

問題: You shouldn't drink too (     ) wine.
解説: too much wine(wine は不可算)。

問題: He gave us (     ) advice about choosing a gift.
解説: some advice「助言」。advice は不可算。

問題: Why don't we go to a convenience store? We have (     ) time to.
解説: enough time「十分な時間」。

問題:
はしかはその地域の多くの子供たちの命を奪った。
Measles has killed (     ) large number of children in the region.
解説: a large number of ~「多数の〜」。

問題: I found her talk very (     ).
解説: find + O + C「Oが〜と感じる」。interesting。

問題: I'm going to skype with my friend in Brazil, so I have to keep (     ).
解説: keep awake「眠らないでいる」。awake は形容詞。

問題: I can call you back later if (     ) to talk now.
選択肢B: it is not convenient for you
解説: if it is not convenient for you「ご都合が悪ければ」。convenient は人を主語にしない。

問題: It is (     ) that she should make such a mistake.
解説: It is impossible that ~「〜はありえない」。capable は人を主語にする。

問題: This plane is (     ) of carrying as many as 500 passengers.
解説: be capable of ~ing「〜できる」。

問題: They are in the (     ) half of the game now.
解説: the latter half「後半」(latter = 後者の)。

問題: Have you seen her (     ) play?
解説: her latest play「彼女の最新の劇」。

問題:
Our school's recycling project was very (     ).
【和訳】私たちの学校のリサイクル計画は大成功だった。
解説: be 動詞の後の補語なので形容詞 successful「成功した」。successive は「連続する」。

問題:
A dragon is an (     ) animal created in China.
【和訳】龍は中国で生み出された想像上の動物である。
解説: imaginary「想像上の・架空の」。imaginative は「想像力豊かな」。

問題: In discussion, we should be (     ) of minority opinions.
解説: be respectful of ~「〜を尊重する」。respectable は「立派な」。

問題: Make sure the power of recorder is (     ) to record some TV shows.
解説: power is on「電源が入っている」。

問題: I can't believe you (     ) haven't told your parents about your bad grades.
解説: still haven't told「まだ〜していない」(驚き)。

問題: We should not forget the devastating earthquake in Kobe that occurred sixteen years (     ).
解説: sixteen years ago「16年前に」。

問題:
Strange! Natalie isn't here today. She is (     ) absent from school.
【和訳】変だな。今日はナタリーがいない。彼女が学校を休むことはめったにないのに。
解説: seldom「めったに〜ない」。「彼女が欠席するのはめったにない」から Strange! の流れになる。often / usually では不自然。

問題: He was (     ) frozen to death.
解説: almost frozen to death「凍死寸前」。

問題: We are getting worried about Mary because we haven't seen her (     ).
解説: haven't seen her lately「最近彼女に会っていない」。

問題: Her novel ranked (     ) on the bestseller list.
解説: ranked high「上位にランクされた」(副詞の high)。

問題: (     ), most tornadoes happen in open country, where nobody lives.
解説: Fortunately「幸いなことに」。

問題: Who (     ) went with Tom?
解説: Who else ~?「他に誰が〜」。

問題: What (     ) up to recently ?
解説: What have you been up to?「最近どうしてた?」。

問題: People in this train are (     ).
解説: much too many「あまりにも多すぎる」。

問題: I still remember when I saw her (     ).
解説: the first time? 「初めて会ったとき」。I remember when I first saw her。

問題: Ann and Ben aren't as well matched as they thought (     ).
解説: at first「最初は」。

問題: We need to leave now. (     ), we may miss the train.
解説: Otherwise「さもなければ」。

問題: The weather was bad, (     ) the trip was perfect.
解説: but otherwise「でもそれ以外は」。

問題: We are satisfied with your products. (     ), we will order them again.
解説: Therefore「だから」。

問題:
In Japan, children enjoy hearty meals during school lunchtime. (     ), not very many people know how and when
Japanese schools started to serve lunch.
解説: However「しかし」。

問題: Greenhouse gases are increasing. (     ), the atmosphere and the sea are getting warmer and warmer.
解説: Consequently「その結果」。

問題: We were supposed to play soccer, but it was raining. We played basketball (     ).
解説: instead「その代わりに」。

問題:
日本語の意味に合う英文を選びなさい。
ジョアンがようやく来た時，レベッカは10分前に去った後だった。
選択肢A: When Juan finally came, Rebecca left 10 minutes ago.
選択肢B: When Juan finally arrived, Rebecca had left 10 minutes ago.
選択肢C: When Juan finally arrived, Rebecca had left 10 minutes before.
選択肢D: When Juan finally reached, Rebecca left 10 minutes before.
解説: had left 10 minutes before「その10分前に出発していた」(過去完了+before)。

問題:
日本語の意味に合う英文を選びなさい。
今年の夏はほとんど雨が降りませんでした。
選択肢A: There were little rainy days this summer.
選択肢B: There were few rainy days this summer.
選択肢C: There were any rainy days this summer.
選択肢D: There were a little rainy days this summer.
解説: few rainy days「ほとんど雨の日がなかった」。few は可算複数名詞。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
"Do you like this color? Or, that color?"
"<u>I don't like either of them.</u>"
選択肢A: I don't like this color, and I don't like that color, either.
選択肢B: I like this color, but I don't like that color.
選択肢D: I cannot tell which I like.
解説: I don't like either of them ≒ A。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
We must take care of the baby <u>by turns</u>.
解説: by turns「交代で」≒ one after another。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
My son has <u>quite a few</u> CDs by the Beatles.
解説: quite a few「かなり多くの」≒ many。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The bus didn't come. <u>Moreover</u>, it began to rain.
解説: Moreover ≒ Besides「その上」。

問題:
下線部と同じような意味を表すものを，選びなさい。
Every time he plays tennis, he takes <u>considerable</u> time to warm up.
解説: considerable「かなりの」≒ a lot of。

問題:
(a)での語の定義にふさわしく，かつ(b)の空所に入る適語を選びなさい。
(a) barely; not much or very little
(b) The room is so dark that we can (     ) see.
解説: scarcely =「ほとんど〜ない」(barely)。can scarcely see「ほとんど見えない」。【同意表現】hardly / barely。

問題:
(a)での語の定義にふさわしく，かつ(b)の空所に入る適語を選びなさい。
(a) also; besides; in addition to that
(b) You came late to class, and (     ), you didn't do your homework.
解説: moreover =「その上」(also / besides / in addition to that)。【同意表現】besides / furthermore。

問題:
(a)での語の定義にふさわしく，かつ(b)の空所に入る適語を選びなさい。
(a) associated more with one person or thing; mainly
(b) This textbook was designed (     ) for Japanese students studying English.
解説: especially =「特に」(associated more with one person or thing; mainly)。designed especially for ~「特に〜向けに作られた」。

問題:
２つの文がほぼ同じ意味になるように，空所に入る適切なものを選びなさい。
(a) What Japanese food do you like best, Mr. Wilson?
(b) What is your (     ) Japanese food, Mr. Wilson?
解説: What is your favorite ~? ≒ What ~ do you like best?

問題:
２つの文がほぼ同じ意味になるように，空所に入る適切なものを選びなさい。
(a) Very few of my friends smoke.
(b) Hardly (     ) of my friends smoke.
解説: Hardly any of ~(ほとんど〜ない)≒ Very few of ~。

問題: 下線部に「誤りのある」英文を選びなさい。
選択肢A: Be careful not to cut <u>yourself</u> with the knife.
選択肢C: I cannot carry this desk all by <u>myself</u>.
選択肢D: The queen saw <u>herself</u> in the mirror.
解説: Cars are not dangerous in themselves.(主語 Cars が複数なので itself は themselves)。in itself「それ自体は」。誤りはB。

問題: 下線部に「誤りのある」英文を選びなさい。
選択肢B: There are <u>much</u> reasons why I moved to New York.
選択肢C: There's far too <u>much</u> work to finish today.
選択肢D: We had so <u>much</u> rain that the river flooded the city.
解説: reasons は可算名詞の複数形なので many。誤りはB(much → many)。B以外の much は不可算名詞(joy, work, rain)に使われている。

問題:
空所に共通して入るものを選びなさい。
(a) A great (     ) of money has been spent on this building.
(b) The managers don't know how to (     ) with this situation at work.
解説: 共通語は deal。(a) a great deal of ~「多量の〜」、(b) deal with ~「〜を処理する」。number は可算名詞に使う。

問題:
The prime minister looked pretty (     ) with the result of the international conference.
【和訳】首相は国際会議の結果にかなり満足しているようだった。
解説: be satisfied with ~「〜に満足している」。look + 形容詞(過去分詞形)。問題文では satisfy を適切な形に変える。

問題:
与えられた英文とほぼ同じ意味を表すものを選びなさい。
Illness made her unable to attend the meeting.
選択肢A: She pretended to be ill and did not attend the meeting.
選択肢B: She attended the meeting on behalf of the person who became ill.
選択肢C: She became ill but was able to attend the meeting.
選択肢D: She became ill, and therefore, she could not attend the meeting.
解説: Illness made her unable to attend ~ =「病気のせいで出席できなかった」=D(She became ill, and therefore, she could not attend)。無生物主語構文。

問題:
They offered Jane the job but she <u>turned it down</u>.
下線部とほぼ同じ意味を表す語(句)を答えなさい。
【和訳】彼らはジェーンにその仕事を提示したが、彼女は断った。
解説: turn down =「断る」≒ refuse / reject / decline。put off(延期する)と区別。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Today's game has already been <u>canceled</u> due to heavy rain.
解説: call off =「中止する」≒ cancel。「今日の試合は大雨で中止された」。call back / call up と区別。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Young children <u>pick up</u> words they hear their elders use.
解説: pick up =「(自然に)覚える」≒ learn。「幼い子は年長者の使う言葉を覚える」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The university <u>organized</u> a programming contest.
解説: set up =「設立する、企画する」≒ organize。【同意表現】establish / arrange。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
I don't want to <u>take on</u> any extra work willingly.
解説: take on =「引き受ける」≒ undertake。【同意表現】accept / take up。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Whatever your decision is, I will <u>back you up</u>.
解説: back up =「支援する」≒ support。【同意表現】stand by / help。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
If you want to apply, you must <u>fill out</u> these papers now.
解説: fill out =「(書類に)記入する」≒ complete。【同意表現】fill in。

問題:
Kate always <u>shows off</u> the big diamond ring she got from her fiance.
下線部とほぼ同じ意味の動詞(三単現)を答えなさい。
【和訳】ケイトは婚約者からもらった大きなダイヤの指輪をいつも見せびらかしている。
解説: show off =「見せびらかす」≒ display / flaunt。

問題:
If you had known better, you wouldn't have been <u>taken in</u> by Bill.
下線部とほぼ同じ意味の過去分詞を答えなさい。
【和訳】もっと分別があれば、ビルにだまされなかっただろうに。
解説: take in =「だます」≒ deceive / fool / trick。「取り込む」「理解する」の意味もある。

問題:
We were so worried since we did not hear (     ) you at all.
【和訳】あなたから全く連絡がなかったので、私たちはとても心配した。
解説: hear from ~ =「〜から便りがある」≒ receive a letter from。hear of は「〜のうわさを聞く」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
I <u>came across</u> an old letter when I was looking through my papers.
解説: come across =「偶然見つける」≒ find。【同意表現】run across / happen upon。

問題:
My brother parted (     ) all his money.
【和訳】兄はお金を全部手放した。
解説: part with ~ =「〜を手放す」(≒ spend / give up)。part from は「〜と別れる」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
He <u>set about</u> learning about the stock market.
解説: set about ~ing =「〜に取りかかる」≒ start / begin。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
How did you <u>recover from</u> your cold so quickly?
解説: get over =「(病気などから)回復する」≒ recover from。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
<u>Go over</u> your work before you hand it in.
解説: go over =「見直す、調べる」≒ check / review / look over。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
I <u>called on</u> my friend in New York last month.
解説: call on + 人 =「(人)を訪問する」≒ visit。call at + 場所と区別。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Sometimes you have to <u>go through</u> hardship in life.
解説: go through =「(苦難を)経験する、耐える」≒ endure / undergo。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
We can't <u>carry on</u> if you won't co-operate.
解説: carry on =「続ける」≒ continue。【同意表現】go on / keep on。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
How could you <u>stand by</u> him after he was found guilty?
解説: stand by =「支持する、味方する」≒ support。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The manager of the company promised to <u>look into</u> the matter at once.
解説: look into =「調べる」≒ examine / investigate。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Fresh vegetables are hard to <u>come by</u> in the winter.
解説: come by =「手に入れる」≒ get / obtain。hard to come by =「手に入りにくい」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Once the men were on board, they immediately <u>headed for</u> the island.
解説: head for ~ =「〜へ向かう」≒ move in the direction of。

問題:
She doesn't really care (     ) Japanese food.
【和訳】彼女は日本料理があまり好きではない。
解説: care for ~ =「〜が好きだ」(否定文・疑問文で多用)。≒ like。「〜の世話をする」の意味もある。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
If the day <u>turns out</u> wet, we must change our plan.
解説: turn out + 形容詞 =「(結局)〜とわかる」≒ prove to be。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Unfortunately, my sister <u>passed away</u> recently, but I keep her in my heart.
解説: pass away =「亡くなる」≒ die(婉曲表現)。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Your clothes have <u>been made useless by wear</u> and should be replaced.
解説: worn out =「(使い古されて)役に立たない」。be made useless by wear =「摩耗で使えなくなった」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Several points <u>stood out</u> in her argument.
解説: stand out =「目立つ、際立つ」≒ be notable。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Do you know how this accident <u>came about</u>?
解説: come about =「起こる」≒ happen / take place。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Susan always <u>breaks in on</u> our conversation.
解説: break in on ~ =「〜に割り込む」≒ interrupt。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Finally, I <u>came up with</u> a solution to that difficult problem.
解説: come up with ~ =「〜を思いつく」≒ think of。【同意表現】hit upon。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Even friends need to <u>tolerate</u> each other sometimes.
解説: put up with ~ =「〜を我慢する」≒ tolerate / stand / bear。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
He is <u>looked up to</u> by all his students, because his research is so distinguished.
解説: look up to ~ =「〜を尊敬する」≒ respect。反対は look down on。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Mr. Garcia <u>looks down</u> on anyone who hasn't had a college education.
解説: look down on ~ =「〜を見下す」≒ despise。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
I don't think I'll be able to <u>complete</u> all this work by tomorrow.
解説: get through ~ =「(仕事を)やり終える」≒ complete。【同意表現】finish。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The committee did their best to <u>compensate for</u> the loss.
解説: make up for ~ =「〜を埋め合わせる」≒ compensate for。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
They want to <u>do away with</u> the old customs.
解説: do away with ~ =「〜を廃止する」≒ get rid of / abolish。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
If you plan to go to America next month, you had better <u>brush up on</u> your English.
解説: brush up on ~ =「〜を磨き直す」≒ review。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
You should <u>get rid of</u> the books that you no longer read as soon as possible.
解説: get rid of ~ =「〜を捨てる」≒ discard / throw away。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Are you going to <u>take part in</u> that speech contest?
解説: take part in ~ =「〜に参加する」≒ participate in。

問題:
I played a video game to (     ) time until we were supposed to meet.
【和訳】待ち合わせの時間まで、時間をつぶすためにテレビゲームをした。
解説: kill time =「時間をつぶす」。spend time は「時間を過ごす」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
He had to <u>take various factors into consideration</u> when deciding which university to apply for.
選択肢A: visit various kinds of university facilities
選択肢C: decide which faculty he was going to study in
選択肢D: think deeply about many different matters
解説: take ~ into consideration =「〜を考慮する」≒ think deeply about。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
You should <u>hold your tongue</u> in public about sensitive political issues.
解説: hold one's tongue =「黙っている」≒ say nothing。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Her strange behavior <u>got on my nerves</u>.
解説: get on one's nerves =「神経にさわる」≒ annoy。

問題:
It made no (     ) to me whether Jack came to the party or not.
【和訳】ジャックがパーティーに来ようが来まいが、私にはどうでもよかった。
解説: make no difference to ~ =「〜にとって重要でない」≒ be unimportant。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
I think they will be able to <u>take advantage of</u> his good nature.
解説: take advantage of ~ =「〜につけこむ」≒ exploit。「〜を利用する」の意味もある。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
You must <u>put an end to</u> such a gossip.
解説: put an end to ~ =「〜を終わらせる」≒ stop。【同意表現】bring ~ to an end。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The company has <u>taken on</u> some engineers recently.
解説: take on =「雇う」≒ employ。「最近技術者を雇った」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
He <u>called up</u> his friend to invite him to go drinking.
解説: call up =「電話をかける」≒ ring / telephone。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
She <u>raised</u> three children by herself.
解説: raise =「育てる」≒ bring up。「3人の子どもを1人で育てた」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Do you know what <u>brought about</u> her change of mind?
解説: bring about ~ =「〜を引き起こす」≒ cause。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
We cannot <u>rule out</u> the possibility of an earthquake.
解説: rule out ~ =「〜を除外する」≒ exclude。「地震の可能性を排除できない」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The committee <u>consists of</u> twelve members.
解説: consist of ~ =「〜から成る」≒ be made up of / be composed of。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
I am not confident enough to <u>handle</u> this situation.
解説: handle =「扱う」≒ deal with / cope with。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
His recent discoveries greatly <u>added to</u> his reputation.
解説: add to ~ =「〜を増やす」≒ increase。「名声を大いに高めた」。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
This job <u>calls for</u> someone with good eyesight.
解説: call for ~ =「〜を必要とする」≒ require / demand。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
He <u>set off</u> to visit Canada with all his things left behind .
解説: set off =「出発する」≒ set out。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
The bus <u>pulled up</u> at the stop
.
解説: pull up =「(車が)止まる」≒ stop。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
Ken <u>felt ashamed</u> because he couldn't answer such an easy question.
解説: lose face =「面目を失う」(feel ashamed のときの表現)。

問題:
下線部とほぼ同じ意味になるものを選びなさい。
He <u>had words</u> with her mother last night.
解説: have words with ~ =「〜と口論する」≒ have a quarrel。

問題:
Clerk：Can I help you?
Customer：Yes, that dress looks really gorgeous.
Clerk：(     )
Customer：May I?
選択肢D: Would you like to try it on?
解説: 店員の Would you like to try it on?「試着してみますか」。customer の May I?(試着してもいいですか)に自然につながる。

問題:
A：Be quiet! I can't hear the TV.
B：Why don't you (     ) the volume?
解説: turn up =「(音量を)上げる」。反対は turn down。【例】Turn up the radio.(ラジオの音量を上げて。)

問題:
今日できることを明日に延ばすな。
Never put (     ) till tomorrow what you can do today.
解説: put off =「延期する」。「今日できることを明日に延ばすな」。【例】Don't put off the work until tomorrow.(仕事を明日に延ばすな。)

問題: A friend of mine arranged that the shuttle bus (     ) me up at the airport and take me to our hotel.
解説: pick up =「(車で)迎えに行く」。【例】I'll pick you up at the station.(駅まで迎えに行くよ。)

問題: Your room is a mess, children. (     ) away these books before you go to bed.
解説: put away =「片付ける」。【例】Put away your toys.(おもちゃを片付けなさい。)

問題: Some people can't figure (     ) how to use a computer.

解説: make use of ~ =「〜を利用する」。【例】Make use of this chance.(この機会を利用しなさい。)

問題: If you fall to the ground during your speech, you will (     ) a fool of yourself.
解説: make a fool of oneself =「笑いものになる」。

問題: As a high school student, Ken (     ) reading the newspaper every day.
解説: make a point of ~ing =「〜することにしている」。

問題:
You should take care (     ) him as his superior.
【和訳】上司として彼の面倒を見るべきだ。
解説: take care of ~ =「〜の世話をする」≒ look after / care for。

問題: This members card still (     ) good.
解説: hold good =「有効である」。【例】The rule still holds good.(その規則は今も有効だ。)

問題: I pointed (     ) that he dislikes sweets.
解説: point out =「指摘する」。【例】He pointed out my mistake.(彼は私の間違いを指摘した。)

問題:
A： I'm going home now.
B： I'm staying a little longer.
A： All right. (     ) that the lights are off when you leave.
解説: see to it that ~ =「〜するよう取り計らう」。【例】See to it that the door is locked.(ドアに必ず鍵をかけておいて。)

問題:
空所に入る語句の組み合わせとして，正しいものを選びなさい。
The letter was so (     ) written I could never (     ) out what it said.
解説: badly written / make out =「読み取る」。

問題:
(a) Turn (     ) the television and do your homework immediately.
(b) In this shop, you can get 10 percent (     ) with a student ID card.
【和訳】(a) テレビを消して、すぐに宿題をやりなさい。
(b) この店では、学生証で10パーセントの割引が受けられます。
解説: (a) turn off ~ =「〜を消す」、(b) 10 percent off =「1割引」。共通語は off。

問題:
空所に共通して入るものを選びなさい。
(a) They will (     ) up after such an argument.
(b) We'll go out if there's a (     ) in the rain.
解説: break =「(関係が)壊れる / 小休止」。

問題:
(a) Don't step into the grass.
(b) Keep (     ) the grass.
【和訳】(a) 芝生に入るな。
(b) 芝生に立入禁止。
解説: keep off ~ =「〜に近寄らない・立ち入らない」。keep out of は「〜に入らない」。

問題:
２つの文がほぼ同じ意味になるように，空所に入る適切なものを選びなさい。
(a) I stayed at a country inn.
(b) I put (     ) at a country inn.
解説: put up at ~ =「〜に泊まる」。【例】We put up at a small hotel.(小さなホテルに泊まった。)

問題:
２つの文がほぼ同じ意味になるように，空所に入る適切なものを選びなさい。
(a) Because of global warming, polar bears might die (     ) soon.
(b) Because of global warming, all the polar bears might disappear soon.
解説: die out =「絶滅する」。【例】Dinosaurs died out long ago.(恐竜はずっと昔に絶滅した。)

問題:
２つの文がほぼ同じ意味になるように，空所に入る適切なものを選びなさい。
(a) Please see to it that the doors upstairs are locked.
(b) Please (     ) sure that the doors upstairs are locked.
解説: make sure =「確かめる」。【例】Make sure you lock the door.(必ずドアに鍵をかけて。)

問題:
与えられた英文とほぼ同じ意味を表すものを選びなさい。
Jane will see to it that the door is locked.
選択肢A: Jane will check the door to make sure it is locked.
選択肢B: Jane will make sure nobody tries to unlock the door.
選択肢C: Jane will repair the lock on the door.
選択肢D: Jane will try to unlock the door herself.
解説: see to it that ~ =「〜するよう気をつける」。【例】I'll see to it that it gets done.(必ずやっておきます。)

問題:
与えられた英文とほぼ同じ意味を表すものを選びなさい。
We all have to do our part to clean up the environment.
選択肢A: Creating a nice environment is a good plan for all of us.
選択肢B: Everyone must cooperate in cleaning up the environment.
選択肢C: It is everyone's duty to clean up every area of the environment.
選択肢D: Some of us have to clean all areas of the environment.
解説: do one's part =「自分の役割を果たす」。【例】Everyone must do their part.(誰もが自分の役割を果たすべきだ。)

問題:
次の定義に当てはまる熟語を答えなさい。
to meet by chance
解説: run across ~ =「偶然出会う」(= meet by chance)≒ come across / run into / bump into。

問題: 次の英文の中で，「誤りのあるもの」を選びなさい。
選択肢A: Did you find the journey pleasant?
選択肢B: He succeeded to find a taxi.
選択肢D: They failed to find their train.
解説: succeed in ~ing「〜に成功する」(前置詞 in)。誤りはB(to find → in finding)。

問題: 次の英文の中で，「誤りのあるもの」を選びなさい。
解説: agree with + 人・意見 / agree to + 提案。誤りはD(to → with)。

問題:
(a) The Johnsons did their best to make their guests feel at (     ).
(b) He gave me his (     ) phone number and told me to call him for help if necessary.
【和訳】(a) ジョンソン家の人々は、客がくつろげるよう最善を尽くした。
(b) 彼は私に自宅の電話番号を教え、必要なら助けを求めて電話するように言った。
解説: 共通語は home。(a) feel at home =「くつろぐ」、(b) home phone number =「自宅の電話番号」。

問題:
(a) Nancy was robbed (     ) her wallet last night.
(b) All (     ) a sudden, Joan hit on a good idea.
【和訳】(a) ナンシーは昨夜、財布を奪われた。
(b) 突然、ジョーンはよい考えを思いついた。
解説: (a) rob A of B =「AからBを奪う」、(b) all of a sudden =「突然」。共通語は of。

問題:
空所に共通して入るものを選びなさい。
(a) We'd like to see him some (     ) time.
(b) Could you turn it the (     ) way around?
解説: some other time「いつか別の機会に」、the other way around「逆に」。共通語は other。

問題:
(a) Today's match was cancelled on (     ) of the approaching typhoon.
(b) It is not easy to open a bank (     ) if you don't have any money.
【和訳】(a) 今日の試合は台風が近づいているため中止された。
(b) お金がなければ銀行口座を開くのは簡単ではない。
解説: (a) on account of ~ =「〜のために」、(b) bank account =「銀行口座」。共通語は account。

問題: Jenny's husband is in the hospital because he was (     ) in a serious traffic accident last week.
解説: be involved in ~ =「〜に巻き込まれる、関与する」。「重大な交通事故に巻き込まれた」。【例】He was involved in an accident.(彼は事故に巻き込まれた。)

問題: "What are you doing these days?" "I'm (     ) about dance. I take dance classes every day."
解説: be crazy about ~ =「〜に夢中だ」≒ be mad about / be wild about。【例】She is crazy about tennis.(彼女はテニスに夢中だ。)

問題:
He was so absorbed (     ) reading the book that he forgot to e-mail Mary.
【和訳】彼は本を読むのに夢中になって、メアリーにメールを送るのを忘れてしまった。
解説: be absorbed in ~ =「〜に夢中になる」≒ be lost in / be immersed in。

問題: We didn't buy anything because we were (     ) of money.
解説: be short of ~ =「〜が不足している」。「お金が足りなかったので何も買わなかった」。【同意表現】run short of / lack。【例】We are short of time.(時間が足りない。)

問題:
DNA barcoding is a movement to catalog all life on earth by using a simple standardized genetic tag, similar (     ) stores labeling products with unique barcodes.
【和訳】DNAバーコーディングは、店が商品に固有のバーコードを付けるのと同様に、単純で標準化された遺伝子タグを用いて地球上の全生物を分類しようとする運動である。
解説: be similar to ~ =「〜に似ている」。similar to stores labeling ~ =「店が〜を表示するのと似て」。

問題:
This train is (     ) for Kyoto.
【和訳】この電車は京都行きだ。
解説: be bound for ~ =「〜行きである」。be bound to V は「きっと〜する」で区別する。

問題: Mr. Moore (     ) for meetings.
解説: 頻度の副詞 sometimes は be 動詞の後ろ(is sometimes late)。「ムーア氏は会議にときどき遅れる」。

問題: Our professor is known (     ) his teaching skills.
解説: be known for ~ =「〜(理由)で知られている」。be known as ~ は「〜として」、be known to ~ は「〜に知られている」。【例】Kyoto is known for its temples.(京都は寺で知られている。)

問題: Susan will be responsible (     ) the kids while we are away.
解説: be responsible for ~ =「〜に責任がある」。「私たちの留守中、スーザンが子どもたちの世話を担当する」。【例】He is responsible for the accident.(彼はその事故に責任がある。)

問題: We are proud (     ) our country's fine heritage.
解説: be proud of ~ =「〜を誇りに思う」。【同意表現】take pride in ~。【例】I'm proud of my son.(息子を誇りに思う。)

問題: I am not opposed (     ) into business and getting jobs.
解説: be opposed to ~ =「〜に反対している」。to の後は動名詞(その意味上の主語 women)。women going into business。

問題:
歯に害を及ぼす可能性が最も高いものは酸による攻撃である。
The thing most (     ) to harm your teeth is an acid attack.
解説: be likely to V =「〜しそうだ」。「歯に害を与える可能性が最も高いのは酸の攻撃」。【例】It is likely to rain tomorrow.(明日は雨が降りそうだ。)

問題: You're (     ) to get injured if you don't get regular exercise.
解説: be bound to V =「きっと〜する」。「運動しないとけがをするに決まっている」。【同意表現】be sure to V。【例】You are bound to succeed.(あなたはきっと成功する。)

問題: (     ) turn in this homework by next week?
解説: be supposed to V =「〜することになっている」。Are we supposed to turn in this homework by next week?

問題:
Can you turn the shirt (     ) out?
【和訳】そのシャツを裏返しにしてくれる?
解説: turn ~ inside out =「〜を裏返す」。upside down は「逆さまに」。

問題:
これまで，この辺りで熊を見かけたことはない。
I haven't seen any bears around here so (     ).
解説: so far =「これまでのところ」。【同意表現】up to now / until now。【例】So far, so good.(今のところ順調だ。)

問題: The heavy rain in eastern Japan, which lasted two days, caused flooding, landslides and *blackouts, (     ) disturbing rail services and closing roads.(*blackout: failure of electric power supply)
解説: ~ as well as ... =「…だけでなく〜も」。「洪水や土砂崩れに加え、鉄道の運行を乱し道路も閉鎖した」。

問題: (     ), his plan would be better than all the others.
解説: By and large =「概して」≒ on the whole / generally speaking。

問題: I didn't agree to give him any advice, (     ) help him.
解説: let alone ~ =「〜は言うまでもなく(否定文)」。「助言に同意しなかったし、まして助けることなどしない」。【同意表現】not to mention。

問題: It rained four days (     ).
解説: on end =「続けて」。four days on end =「4日間ぶっ通しで」。【例】It snowed for three days on end.(3日間降り続けた。)

問題: I have not seen my cousins in Spain for (     ).
解説: for ages =「長い間」。【同意表現】for a long time。【例】I haven't seen him for ages.(ずいぶん彼に会っていない。)

問題: Angela has gone back to Germany (     ). That means she will not return to Japan again.
解説: for good =「永遠に」≒ forever / for ever。【例】He left Japan for good.(彼は日本を永久に去った。)

問題:
"Be sure to be on time tomorrow." "Don't worry. I'll be there at nine o'clock without (     )."
【和訳】「明日は必ず時間どおりに来てね」「心配しないで。必ず9時にそこにいるよ」
解説: without fail =「必ず、間違いなく」。

問題: The negotiations lasted for days, apparently to no (     ).
解説: to no purpose =「むだに」≒ in vain。to no avail。【例】All our efforts were to no purpose.(我々の努力はむだだった。)

問題: Could I have your handy phone number, (     )?
解説: just in case =「念のため」。【同意表現】to be safe。【例】Take an umbrella just in case.(念のため傘を持って行って。)

問題: The director, Michael Rost is going to appear (     ) person at the ceremony.
解説: in person =「本人が直接」。【同意表現】personally。【例】The singer appeared in person.(その歌手は本人が登場した。)

問題: Tom came late but still (     ) time to catch the plane.
解説: in time (for ~) =「間に合って」。on time は「時間どおりに」。【例】We arrived in time for the train.(電車に間に合った。)

問題:
I couldn't get the information I needed because the Web site is currently (     ) construction.
【和訳】現在ウェブサイトが工事中のため、必要な情報が得られなかった。
解説: under construction =「工事中・建設中」。under repair =「修理中」など〈under + 名詞〉で「〜中」。

問題: Your birthday is near (     ) hand.
解説: near at hand =「すぐ近くに」。close at hand も同意。【例】Help is near at hand.(助けはすぐそばにある。)

問題:
メアリーといるとものすごく落ち着くんだ。彼女は誰に対しても優しいから。
I feel quite (     ) ease when I'm with Mary. She is kind to everybody.
解説: at ease =「くつろいで」。feel at ease =「気楽に感じる」。【例】I felt at ease with her.(彼女といると気が楽だった。)

問題: I thought I was going to fail the examination, but I passed (     ).
解説: after all =「結局」。「落ちると思ったが結局合格した」。【例】After all, he came.(結局彼は来た。)

問題: Kevin liked all his classes, but he enjoyed his music class in (     ).
解説: in particular =「特に」≒ especially。【例】I like all fruit, apples in particular.(果物は全部好きだが、特にりんごが好きだ。)

問題: The professor has a wide range of interests and is never at a (     ) for the topics of conversation.
解説: at a loss =「途方に暮れて」。never at a loss for ~ =「〜に困ることがない」。【例】I was at a loss for words.(言葉に詰まった。)

問題:
Do you have a 100 yen coin (     ) any chance?
【和訳】ひょっとして100円玉を持っていませんか。
解説: by any chance =「ひょっとして」(丁寧に尋ねる)。by chance =「偶然」。

問題: My computer is out of (     ).
解説: out of date =「時代遅れの」。反対は up to date。【例】This map is out of date.(この地図は古い。)

問題: Sorry this elevator is (     ) of order. Please use another one.
解説: out of order =「故障して」。【例】The machine is out of order.(その機械は故障中だ。)

問題: Your presentation is taking too long, so please get (     ) and finish up quickly.
解説: get to the point =「要点に入る」。

問題: On (     ) thought, I decided not to buy the car.
解説: on second thought =「考え直して」。【例】On second thought, I'll stay.(考え直して、残ることにした。)

問題: (     ) my opinion, she is right.
解説: In my opinion =「私の意見では」。≒ I think / to my mind。【例】In my opinion, he is wrong.(私の意見では彼は間違っている。)

問題:
(     ) a rule, Japanese cars are more economical than foreign cars.
【和訳】概して、日本車は外国車より経済的だ。
解説: as a rule =「概して」≒ in general / by and large。

問題: We had a lot of trouble with our house. (     ), we decided to move out.
解説: In the end =「最終的に」≒ finally / eventually。【例】In the end, we agreed.(結局、私たちは合意した。)

問題:
Jack doesn't work, in (     ) words, he is idle.
【和訳】ジャックは働かない、言い換えれば怠け者だ。
解説: in other words =「言い換えれば」≒ that is (to say)。

問題:
I badly need a new car, but for the time (     ) I can't afford one.
【和訳】新しい車がどうしても必要だが、当分の間は買う余裕がない。
解説: for the time being =「当分の間」。

問題:
As a (     ) of fact, I think he's quite good-looking.
【和訳】実を言うと、彼はかなりの二枚目だと思う。
解説: as a matter of fact =「実際は」≒ in fact / actually。

問題: The TV program is harmful from an educational point of (     ).
解説: from ~ point of view =「〜の観点から」。【例】From my point of view, it's a mistake.(私の見方では、それは間違いだ。)

問題: I said nothing about it (     ) his wife's being there.
解説: because of ~ =「〜のために」。「彼の妻がそこにいたので、それについては何も言わなかった」。【例】We stayed home because of the rain.(雨のため家にいた。)

問題: (     ) wide-screen televisions and DVD players, most young people prefer to watch movies at home.
解説: Thanks to ~ =「〜のおかげで」。「ワイドテレビやDVDのおかげで」。【例】Thanks to your help, I succeeded.(あなたのおかげで成功した。)

問題: Ironically, Japanese people, (     ) their love of scenic beauties, have done as much as any people to defile them.
解説: with all ~ =「〜にもかかわらず」≒ despite / in spite of。【例】With all his faults, I like him.(欠点はあるが、彼が好きだ。)

問題:
The film Cassandra's Dream is set in London, but (     ) the director's understanding of London and the nuances of
Londoners' language, it might as well have been Mars.
解説: for all ~ =「〜にもかかわらず」≒ in spite of。【例】For all his wealth, he is unhappy.(裕福なのに彼は不幸だ。)

問題: The construction work must be finished by the end of the month (     ) of cost.
解説: regardless of ~ =「〜にかかわらず」。【例】He went regardless of the danger.(彼は危険をものともせず行った。)

問題: My sister went to Austria (     ) studying music for a year.
解説: for the purpose of ~ =「〜の目的で」。

問題: After the incident, there was considerable doubt (     ) exactly what had happened.
解説: as to ~ =「〜に関して」≒ about / concerning。【例】There is doubt as to his honesty.(彼の誠実さには疑問がある。)

問題: (     ) from the boss, everybody thought we should start the meeting earlier.
解説: Apart from ~ =「〜は別として」≒ aside from。【例】Apart from the price, it's perfect.(値段を除けば完璧だ。)

問題:
It's quite (     )(     ) you to decide which course in life you should take.
【和訳】どの人生を歩むかは、まったくあなた次第だ。
解説: be up to + 人 =「(人)次第だ」。It's up to you.

問題: When the Industrial Revolution took hold, holidays were eliminated (     ) the new work ethic: people were increasingly expected to labor all day and six days a week.
解説: in favor of ~ =「〜に賛成して」。「新しい労働倫理を優先して休日は廃止された」。【例】I'm in favor of the plan.(その計画に賛成だ。)

問題: (     ) an emergency, he is to be contacted.
解説: In case of ~ =「〜の場合には」。【例】In case of fire, use the stairs.(火事の場合は階段を使うこと。)

問題: Ken expressed gratitude (     ) his classmates.
解説: on behalf of ~ =「〜を代表して」。【例】I speak on behalf of the class.(クラスを代表して話す。)

問題:
眠りを犠牲にしてまで働くのはよくありません。
It is not good for you to work (     ).
選択肢A: along the lack of your sleep
選択肢B: at the price of your sleep
選択肢C: for the charge of your sleep
選択肢D: with the fee of your sleep
解説: at the price of ~ =「〜を犠牲にして」。【例】He worked at the price of his health.(彼は健康を犠牲にして働いた。)

問題: Do you know the man who is walking (     ) the direction of our faculty building?
解説: in the direction of ~ =「〜の方向に」。

問題: Our bonuses are dependent (     ) the company's profits.
解説: be dependent on ~ =「〜に依存している」。【例】Our bonuses depend on profits.(ボーナスは利益次第だ。)

問題: I'm financially independent (     ) my parents.
解説: be independent of ~ =「〜から独立している」。【例】He is independent of his parents.(彼は親から独立している。)

問題: I am not familiar (     ) that system.
解説: be familiar with + 物 =「〜をよく知っている」。【例】I'm familiar with this city.(この街によく知っている。)

問題: This song is very familiar (     ) young people.
解説: be familiar to + 人 =「(人)によく知られている」。【例】The song is familiar to everyone.(その歌は誰にもなじみがある。)

問題: I found him a very fair person. He is a man (     ) prejudice.
解説: be free from ~ =「〜がない」。「偏見のない人」。【例】The water is free from pollution.(その水は汚染されていない。)

問題: Be (     ) to tell me where Mary is going.
解説: be sure to V =「必ず〜する」。

問題: I am well aware (     ) the difference between trout and salmon.
解説: be aware of ~ =「〜に気づいている」。【例】I'm aware of the risk.(危険に気づいている。)

問題: Do you know how many people were (     ) in this new project?
解説: be involved in ~ =「〜に関わっている」。

問題: All computers (     ) the threat of various cyber attacks.
解説: be subject to ~ =「〜を受けやすい」。【例】Prices are subject to change.(価格は変更されることがある。)

問題: The taste of this wine is similar (     ) that one, but their prices are completely different.
解説: be similar to ~ =「〜に似ている」。【例】Your idea is similar to mine.(あなたの考えは私のと似ている。)

問題: Indeed, the nature of this region is full (     ) surprises.
解説: be full of ~ =「〜でいっぱいである」。【例】The box is full of toys.(箱はおもちゃでいっぱいだ。)

問題: Matsushima is known in Japan (     ) its beautiful scenery.
解説: be known for ~ =「〜で有名である」。

問題: I'm jealous (     ) his success.
解説: be jealous of ~ =「〜をねたんでいる」。【例】He is jealous of her success.(彼は彼女の成功をねたんでいる。)

問題: He told me he is (     ) about sushi.
解説: be particular about ~ =「〜にうるさい」。

問題:
She was (     ) of her son. He was always first in his class.
【和訳】彼女は息子を誇りに思っていた。彼はいつもクラスで一番だった。
解説: be proud of ~ =「〜を誇りに思う」。pride は名詞で、take pride in ~ の形になる。

問題: The game of basketball (     ) of four quarters.
解説: be composed of ~ =「〜から成る」≒ consist of。【例】The team is composed of ten members.(チームは10人で構成される。)

問題: These drawings must not be exposed (     ) the air.
解説: be exposed to ~ =「〜にさらされる」。【例】Don't expose the film to light.(フィルムを光にさらすな。)

問題: We are acquainted (     ) those visitors from Australia.
解説: be acquainted with ~ =「〜と知り合いである」。【例】I'm acquainted with the mayor.(市長と面識がある。)

問題: I'm (     ) to start my new job. I'm quite excited about it.
解説: be eager to V =「〜したがっている」。【例】He is eager to learn.(彼は学びたがっている。)

問題: According to the survey, women who smoke, even three cigarettes a day, are two to six times (     ) to suffer a heart attack than non-smoking women.
解説: be more likely to V =「〜しやすい」。

問題: People with religious faith (     ) to be more content than those without.
解説: tend to V =「〜する傾向がある」。【例】Prices tend to rise in summer.(夏は物価が上がりがちだ。)

問題: (     ) little is known of the reason he quit.
解説: As yet =「今までのところ」。as yet little is known =「まだほとんどわかっていない」。【例】As yet, nothing has happened.(今のところ何も起きていない。)

問題: We have been assigned a lot of summer homework, but I've already done four fifths of it; I'm as (     ) as finished!
解説: as good as ~ =「〜も同然」。I'm as good as finished!

問題: What (     ) my lack of time and money, I couldn't join any clubs.
解説: with + 名詞 =「〜のために」。What with A and B =「AやBやで」。

問題: He cannot use his left hand (     ) nature.
解説: by nature =「生まれつき」。【例】He is left-handed by nature.(彼は生まれつき左利きだ。)

問題: We are close friends. We have so many things (     ) common.
解説: in common =「共通して」。have ~ in common。【例】We have a lot in common.(私たちは共通点が多い。)

問題:
Come and meet me (     ) person. I can't talk about this over the phone.
【和訳】直接会いに来て。この件は電話では話せない。
解説: in person =「直接本人が」。

問題:
I got to the classroom (     )(     )(     ) the exam.
【和訳】私は試験に間に合うように教室に着いた。
解説: in time for ~ =「〜に間に合って」。on time は「時間どおりに」。

問題: She spent 4 hours walking (     ) nothing.
解説: for nothing =「無駄に」。【例】I waited for an hour for nothing.(1時間待ったがむだだった。)

問題: Please (     ) at home in my house.
解説: make oneself at home =「くつろぐ」。Please make yourself at home。【例】Make yourself at home.(どうぞくつろいで。)

解説: at large =「(犯人が)逃走中で」。【例】The lion is still at large.(ライオンはまだ逃走中だ。)

問題: (     ) short, Ken needs to work harder if he wants to keep his job.
解説: In short =「要するに」。【例】In short, we need more time.(要するに時間が必要だ。)

問題: I understand your feelings (     ), but still it was wrong.
解説: to some extent =「ある程度」。【例】I agree with you to some extent.(ある程度は同意する。)

問題: They tried to maintain peace (     ) any cost.
解説: at any cost =「どんな犠牲を払っても」。【例】We must win at any cost.(何としても勝たねばならない。)

問題: The party got out of (     ), so the neighbors called the police.
解説: get out of hand =「手に負えなくなる」。【例】The party got out of hand.(パーティーは収拾がつかなくなった。)

問題: Everything just seemed to happen all (     ) once.
解説: all at once =「突然」。【例】It all happened at once.(すべてが一度に起こった。)

問題:
It is not good to say bad things about others (     ) their backs.
【和訳】陰で他人の悪口を言うのはよくない。
解説: behind one's back =「陰で・本人のいないところで」。

問題: That was a terrible mistake, but (     ) I learned a lesson from it.
解説: in a sense =「ある意味では」。【例】In a sense, you are right.(ある意味では君が正しい。)

問題: Nobody must enter the room for the time (     ).
解説: for the time being =「当分の間」。【例】Stay here for the time being.(当分ここにいなさい。)

問題: (     ) traffic jams, we will arrive a little later than expected.
解説: Due to ~ =「〜のために」。【例】Due to the rain, the game was canceled.(雨のため試合は中止になった。)

問題: In (     ) of the bad weather, they went out.
解説: In spite of ~ =「〜にもかかわらず」。【例】In spite of the rain, we went out.(雨にもかかわらず出かけた。)

問題: His explanation (     ) how things went wrong was unsatisfactory to us.
解説: as to ~ =「〜に関する」。

問題: (     ) the legend, coffee was discovered by a monk when he saw his goats were excited after they ate berries from a coffee tree.
解説: According to ~ =「〜によれば」。【例】According to the news, it will snow.(ニュースによれば雪だそうだ。)

問題: (     ) to popular belief, those who had won the lottery were no more or less happy than those who hadn't.
解説: Contrary to ~ =「〜に反して」。【例】Contrary to expectations, he failed.(予想に反して彼は失敗した。)

問題: He ate everything (     ) than what he doesn't like.
解説: other than ~ =「〜以外の」。

問題:
English is considered to be an easy language (     )(     )(     ) German.
【和訳】英語はドイツ語に比べて易しい言語だと考えられている。
解説: in comparison with ~ =「〜と比べて」≒ compared with ~。

問題: This is the key she was in search (     ).
解説: in search of ~ =「〜を探して」。【例】He is in search of a job.(彼は仕事を探している。)

問題: The planet Itokawa was named in (     ) of the late Dr. Hideo Itokawa.
解説: in honor of ~ =「〜を記念して」。【例】The hall was named in honor of him.(ホールは彼をたたえて命名された。)

問題: I would like to stay home instead (     ).
解説: instead of ~ing =「〜する代わりに」。【例】I stayed home instead of going out.(外出せず家にいた。)

問題: (     ) of all the participants, I would like to thank the conference organizers for their hard work.
解説: On behalf of ~ =「〜を代表して」。

解説: at the expense of ~ =「〜を犠牲にして」。【例】He succeeded at the expense of his health.(彼は健康を犠牲にして成功した。)

問題: All the birds flew (     ) the direction of the sea.
解説: in the direction of ~ =「〜の方向へ」。
